HP-24 Hydronic Expansion Tank

24-Liter (6.0 Gallon) Tank for Hydronic Heating & Cooling Systems| Aquasky HYDRO-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

HP-24 is a 24-liter (6.0-gallon) expansion tank specifically engineered for closed-loop hydronic heating and cooling systems. It effectively regulates fluid expansion and pressure buildup, ensuring the safety and stability of residential or commercial climate-control setups.

Built for high-performance environments, the tank supports a maximum operating pressure of 10 bar (150 psi) and temperatures up to 130°C (266°F). It is factory pre-charged to 1 bar (15 psi) and is fully compatible with propylene glycol mixtures of up to 50%.

With a diameter of 29.0 cm and a height of 41.95 cm, this mid-to-large capacity tank provides reliable expansion absorption for demanding applications. It is designed for convenient installation alongside non-potable water systems, offering a robust solution in a versatile footprint.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The HP-24 is a 24-liter (6.0 gallon) hydronic expansion tank engineered specifically for closed-loop hydronic heating and cooling systems. As the fluid in your climate-control system changes temperature, it expands and contracts; the HP-24 safely absorbs this expanded fluid volume, effectively controlling the excessive pressure generated inside the system and preventing potential hazards.


Crafted from robust sheet steel tanks compliant with IAPMO and EN standards, the HP-24 is welded according to strict ASME & EN procedures by certified welders, ensuring long-lasting durability and safety. Utilizing a specialized, high-temperature-resistant EPDM rubber diaphragm, it ensures exceptionally reliable operation. To guarantee supreme durability, every single Hydro-Plus model undergoes rigorous hydraulic testing at a pressure 1.5 times higher than the design pressure.


Manufactured with premium materials, Aquasky HYDRO-PLUS tanks are the ultimate safety choice for your hydronic heating system, delivering dependable performance and peace of mind.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • High-temperature resistant EPDM diaphragm for frequent heating/cooling cycles.
  • Durable cold-rolled carbon steel shell, welded to ASME & EN standards by certified welders.
  • 1.5x hydraulic pressure tested for safety and leak prevention.
  • Brass cap with internal O-ring ensures zero air loss from the air-vent.
  • Compatible with up to 50% propylene glycol, versatile for anti-freeze and commercial chillers.
  • Protective gray paint for professional appearance and environmental resistance.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the HYDRO-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

In closed hydronic heating and cooling systems, fluid volume changes drastically as the temperature rises and falls. The HP-24 safely absorbs this expanded fluid using a sealed, compressible air cushion space. It stores the fluid securely against the high-temperature EPDM rubber diaphragm, while the air chamber compresses to accommodate the volume change. This mechanism seamlessly controls excessive pressure, protects valves and piping, and maintains safe system parameters without venting fluid.

Key benefits

  • Absorbs excess fluid volume during thermal cycles.    
  • Protects system components (boilers, piping, valves) from damaging high pressure. 
  • Delivers a safe and stable system for residential and commercial hydronic applications. 
  • Guarantees peace of mind through strict manufacturing standards and a 1.5x design pressure hydraulic test.

Typical Applications 

  • Closed-loop residential and commercial hydronic heating systems.  
  • Hydronic cooling installations. 
  • Non-potable water applications (compatible with up to 50% propylene glycol mixtures).

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : For what size system is the HP-24 typically recommended?

A:  The HP-24 (6.0-gallon) is ideal for larger residential properties or light commercial systems. It is the preferred choice for setups with extensive underfloor heating or large radiator networks where a smaller tank might not provide enough volume to handle total thermal expansion.

Q2 : Does the HP-24 require special maintenance due to its larger capacity?

A: No, it follows the same "low-maintenance" philosophy as the rest of the Hydro-Plus line. However, because it often supports larger, more complex systems, we recommend an annual check of the 1 bar (15 psi) pre-charge to ensure the tank continues to regulate pressure at peak efficiency.

Q3 : How does the HP-24 handle systems that use chemical additives or glycol?

A : The HP-24 is engineered for modern system chemistry. It is fully compatible with up to 50% propylene glycol mixtures, ensuring that the internal diaphragm and shell remain resilient even in systems requiring high levels of freeze protection or specialized corrosion inhibitors.
